name: Greywake Market District
description: A coastal market district built on a tide that does not behave like a tide. Salt streaks every wall and inscribes its own slow handwriting into stone. Three institutions have offices within four streets of each other; they pretend not to notice each other and notice each other very precisely. The fountain at the center is dry, has been dry since before living memory, and leaks upward. Most people do not look at it directly.

exits.label: the Bell-Forge (west alleys)
exits.hiddenDescription: An alley forge half-hidden between two warehouses. Discovered via rumor or by observing brass-smoke from the right alley.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Butcher's Stall
pointsOfInterest.description: A market stall hung with cuts that are not from any animal common to the region. A large man performs the same five-minute cycle of motions for as long as anyone has watched.

pointsOfInterest.name: Salt-Streaked Wall
pointsOfInterest.description: Salt has inscribed its own slow handwriting into the stone. The handwriting is not unreadable. It has just not yet been read.

name: The Dry Fountain
description: A four-tiered fountain of weather-pocked limestone, dry to the eye and yet — when you stand close enough — leaking upward. Faint runnels of black seawater rise an inch above the lip of the topmost basin and dissolve into the air. The salt rime on the lower stones is unbroken. There is no plumbing that should produce this. A single coin lies in the upper basin; nobody removes it.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Carved Lip
pointsOfInterest.description: Names carved in an order you do not yet understand. Some of them you do not yet recognize as names.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Black Water
pointsOfInterest.description: Water that is not wet. Memory held in surface tension. The water rises an inch above the topmost basin and dissolves into the air.

pointsOfInterest.name: The One Coin
pointsOfInterest.description: A single coin lies in the upper basin. Nobody removes it. The coin is older than the fountain.

name: Bell Court Precinct
description: A two-storey ledger-house with a single brass bell hung over the front door. The bell is small and never rings on its own; clerks pull a cord when an entry is committed. Inside: low desks, paper-stacks, glass jars of black ink, and a hush that punishes loud voices. The walls are pinned with notices. Some of the notices are addressed to people who do not exist yet.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Brass Bell
pointsOfInterest.description: Small. Hung over the front door. Never rings on its own; clerks pull a cord when an entry is committed.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Open Ledger
pointsOfInterest.description: The central ledger sits open on Bell-Magistrate Orro's desk. Entries are in three different inks. Reading is not encouraged.

pointsOfInterest.name: Pinned Notices
pointsOfInterest.description: Some of the notices are addressed to people who do not exist yet.

name: Drowned Cathedral Antechamber
description: A long stone chamber, knee-deep in standing water that should not be there. The water has the wrong colour for seawater and the wrong viscosity for fresh; it parts around you and rejoins behind you, slowly. Niches along the walls hold tithing-cups, marrow-wax candles, and small folded prayers written on the inside of dried fish skins. A staircase descends behind a half-open door of rusted iron. Nobody goes down.

exits.label: down the staircase (DOCTRINALLY FORBIDDEN)
exits.hiddenDescription: The descent is open but no Drowned Church member will pass through it. Player attempts trigger Marrow-Saint Ilyra's immediate intervention.

locked.description: Doctrinally forbidden — Drowned Church members will intervene.

pointsOfInterest.name: Tithing-Cup
pointsOfInterest.description: A small brass cup half-filled with the standing water. Coins inside have stopped trying to be coins.

pointsOfInterest.name: Marrow-Wax Candle
pointsOfInterest.description: A drowned-red candle in a wall niche. The candle is taller than it was an hour ago. Nobody has trimmed it.

pointsOfInterest.name: Prayer on Fish-Skin
pointsOfInterest.description: A small folded prayer written on the inside of a dried fish skin. The prayer reads as a name. The name is yours, but not the one you've been using.

name: Tide League Broker's Office
description: A low room behind a heavy door whose latch has been replaced with a brass weighing-pan. Inside: a counter, an abacus that uses bone beads, three scrip-presses, two stools, and a Tide League broker who will look up when you enter and then return to a contract without speaking. Salt-scrip is stacked behind the counter in tied bundles. Above the broker's chair: a chart of the local tides that has been amended in ink so many times the original is unreadable.

pointsOfInterest.name: Amended Tide Chart
pointsOfInterest.description: A chart of the local tides that has been amended in ink so many times the original is unreadable. The most recent amendment is in red.

pointsOfInterest.name: Abacus of Bone
pointsOfInterest.description: An abacus that uses bone beads. The beads warm slightly when transactions are pending.

name: The Bell-Forge
description: A narrow alley forge half-hidden between two warehouses. The Bell-Forge does not have a sign. Its bellows breathe even when nobody works them. The smith — unnamed — works alone and accepts commissions only on days the Bell-Court does not record. The fire here is not orange but a wrong gold, somewhere between brass and lantern. The walls are darkened with use and with the kind of soot that does not come off skin.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Bellows
pointsOfInterest.description: They breathe even when nobody works them. The breath is regular. Five-second intervals.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Wrong-Gold Fire
pointsOfInterest.description: Not orange. Somewhere between brass and lantern. Casts no shadow.
